verdict.rationale: Latency is a fair axis for a real-time video platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents an end-to-end latency target or a measured latency path. The Network Quality API, Video Insights and TURN configuration are related monitoring and transport features, not a documented latency target, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents an end-to-end latency target or measured latency path suitable for live conversation
